note: Streaming robustness (breaking). DIRECT: a response that overflows the pooled buffer is kept natively (overflow stash, new DirectStash natives) and fetched or streamed, so the handler runs once for every method (dispatchDirectPooled with retryOnOverflow=false now succeeds instead of throwing); text/event-stream responses are streamed; the legacy overflow size count is capped by max_buffered_response_bytes; BufferTooSmallException is no longer final. Smart resolver: Accept text/event-stream / application/x-ndjson / application/stream+json -> STREAMING. Streaming: header-first variants flush the OutputStream whenever the body would wait and coalesce ready small frames up to the chunk size. Virtual threads: SYNC dispatches via dispatchAsync + join (parks instead of pinning the carrier). BREAKING limits: more than 1024 request headers answer 431 (used to panic into 500); at most 256 concurrent bidirectional upload producers (vespera.streaming.maxRequestProducers / VESPERA_MAX_STREAMING_REQUEST_PRODUCERS, 0 = unlimited); a dropped upload producer aborts the request body instead of a clean EOF. shutdown0 drains in-flight dispatches of every mode before stopping the runtime, completes a dropped dispatchAsync future with 503, and no longer panics when called from a runtime thread. Cron: no early fire on a wall-clock step back; in a JNI library jobs run on the shared JNI runtime and stop on shutdown. Bridge JAR and cdylib must come from the same release.
